text:
helen_ae: Urgent: Vertex Corp POC load test just started returning a flood of 5xxs during their workshop. Theyre driving short bursts ~140-220 rps. Workshop in 10m. Need a quick, low-risk mitigation + a one-sentence explanation we can give the customer.

mohit_support: Which region and model? Any request_id or error text? Also, did SE get the security questionnaire answers back? They asked about log retention for the demo.

helen_ae: Region = us-east-2, model = redwood-open-4b-q4 (hosted). Example from their harness: 
```
POST /v1/chat.generate
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
x-rw-queue-depth: 67
{"error":"upstream overloaded","request_id":"req_vtx_9982"}
```
SE had sent the security questionnaire last week; customer asked about SOC2 and whether demo logs persist beyond 30 days.

claire_infra: Queue depth 67 + backpressure flag -> autoscaler fell behind and fallback coldstarts too slow. Fast low-risk options: 
1) API-key soft-failover to a 1.5B variant scoped to the customer's key (zero infra spin)
2) temporarily allow burstpool attach for the customer if they consent (warm capacity)
3) as last resort set pool min_replicas=1 for the 4B pool (immediate warm replica but costs more)

mohit_support: Can we scope failover to only route requests >650ms to smaller model? That keeps fidelity for most traffic.

claire_infra: Yes. I can run: 
```
redwoodctl api-keys update --id key-vertex --set failover_model=redwood-open-1_5b-q4 --set failover_latency_threshold=650ms
```
It will route only slow requests to the 1.5B variant. No infra spin.

yvonne_se: Regarding the security questionnaire: confirm SOC2 scope and the demo log retention. Short answer for customer: "Demo logs are retained in-region for 30 days by default; we can adjust retention for POCs on request and provide SOC2 attestation excerpts." I'll DM the exact wording.

pagerbot: Incident created: INC-2026-3043-12 - "vertex p6oc: upstream overload during workshop" (link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-3043-12)

mohit_support: If AE asks about cost delta for prewarming (min_replicas=1) vs failover, what's a quick number for us-east-2? Also any enterprise discounts for POCs?

claire_infra: Quick back-of-envelope: min_replicas=1 for 4B in us-east-2 ~+$950/day. For a 1-hour workshop that's roughly +$40. Using failover has near-zero infra cost for short spikes. For enterprise POCs we often provide a week-long trial credit or a negotiated uplift; I'll hand this to finance for exact.

helen_ae: Please flip the API-key failover first (low-risk) and ask the customer if they want temporary burstpool attach. Also they want the one-liner to explain why they saw 5xxs.

claire_infra: Flipping failover now. Command executed and rolling: `failover_model=redwood-open-1_5b-q4 threshold=650ms`.

mohit_support: While that's rolling, grab the proxy trace for req_vtx_9982 and the queue_depth series for the last 25m: `curl -H "x-request-id: req_vtx_9982" https://logs.internal/bundle` and `redwoodctl metrics query --name queue_depth --since 25m --filter customer=vertex`. Also check `pending_coldstarts` for the pool.

helen_ae: Logs and metrics uploaded to INC-2026-3043-12. I told customer: "We enabled an automated latency-based fallback to a smaller model during brief spikes to keep your workshop responsive; full model fidelity is restored once load stabilizes." They accepted temporary burstpool attach if needed.

claire_infra: I enabled allow_burst=true for the customer (temporary for the workshop). That attached a warm burst replica; coldstart avoided.

pagerbot: Action: customer update vertex -> allow_burst=true (deploy d-3043-55).

mohit_support: After both changes, error rate dropped from ~120/min to <10/min within ~90s and latency stabilized. Demo continued.

yvonne_se: Follow-ups (tracking): 
- add a short AE checklist entry: request a 10-minute prewarm window for scheduled workshops or enable failover/burstpool temporarily
- include a POC pricing line in the AE playbook: estimated per-hour prewarm cost and default failover option
- answer: attach SOC2 excerpt and confirm 30-day in-region retention in the POC confirmation email

claire_infra: Infra follow-ups: 
- investigate why burstpool auto-attach thresholds didn't trigger earlier (policy vs metric mismatch)
- evaluate reducing worst-case coldstart from 45s -> 25-30s by pre-pulling kernels for top models
- consider an API to request a "prewarm reservation" when AE schedules a demo

helen_ae: Customer thanked us and workshop concluded successfully. Leaving the incident open for infra and security follow-ups. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
